key_insight: Nano- and micro-textures do more than improve light trapping in perovskite solar cells: they can also improve wetting, crystallinity, carrier extraction, and mechanical robustness.
engineering_relevance: Texture design is a multi-functional interface engineering strategy that can boost efficiency and reliability in perovskite devices, including solar cells, photodetectors, and LEDs.
method: Promote better perovskite-solution wetting and film formation
Leverage texture-induced effects on grain growth, orientation, and stress
evidence_signal: This is a review of recently reported texture-related benefits, synthesizing evidence that textures improve film quality, open-circuit voltage, and bending stability beyond optical management.
watch_item: Texture benefits may depend strongly on fabrication method and device stack, so aggressive patterning could introduce process complexity or nonuniformity.
paper_title: More than just light management -- The multiple advantages of nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells
